usedFor: Smartsheet holds your rows and Trello holds your boards, so “New Row” can run “Create Trello Card”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Row” in Smartsheet, then “Create Trello Card” in Trello
bestTemplate.why: Each new row becomes a Trello card, so work logged in a sheet shows up on the board.

watchOut: “New Row” is polling, so cards appear after a scheduled check, not as soon as the row is added.
